answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1900 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nadir. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the copper queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The pulse index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 70 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
